mainEntity.name: What is Bates numbering and why is it mandatory for court bundles?

mainEntity.name: How does SHA-256 cryptographic hashing prove chat integrity?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cryptographic SHA-256 hash creates a unique 64-character digital fingerprint of the original raw WhatsApp export file. If even a single comma or emoji is altered, the hash changes completely. ChatDocket computes this hash locally using the browser Web Crypto API and stamps it onto every page.
